fact: The party is ambushed by a Trapper in the western passages.
source_quote: The tunnels were silent and oppressive, the kind of silence that hides things.
subject: Trapper ambush

fact: The Trapper achieves surprise because no party member has a passive Perception higher than 18.
source_quote: No one has a passive Perception over 18, so the creature achieves surprise.
subject: surprise achieved

fact: The Trapper is a massive, manta-ray-shaped predator.
source_quote: A massive, manta-ray-shaped predator known as a Trapper
subject: Trapper

fact: The Trapper strikes at the rear of the party.
source_quote: Without warning, something struck at the rear of the party.
subject: Trapper attacks rear

fact: The Trapper wraps its wings around Gyrgum, grappling him.
source_quote: wrapped its great leathery wings around Gyrgum
subject: Gyrgum grappled

fact: Gyrgum loses a DC 13 Dexterity save and is grappled by the Trapper.
source_quote: Gyrgum fails a DC 13 Dexterity save and is grappled.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum makes a joke that the grapple is a 'bat hug' rather than a bear hug.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "Instead of a bear hug, it's a bat hug."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The Trapper has 85 hit points.
source_quote: The Trapper has 85 hit points
subject: Trapper

fact: Thorin rolls a natural 1 for initiative, resulting in 0.
source_quote: Thorin rolls a natural 1 for a 0 initiative
subject: Thorin initiative roll

fact: Thorin notes that this is his second natural one of the night.
source_quote: his "second natural one … so far tonight."
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum takes smothering damage of 15 then 20 points at the start of his turn.
source_quote: He takes the smothering damage at the start of his turn (the DM called 15, then 20 points).
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum uses his orc ability to drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.
source_quote: He uses his orc ability to drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The DM clarifies that the grapple stops movement but allows Gyrgum to attack or cast spells.
source_quote: The DM clarifies that the grapple only stops movement, so Gyrgum could still attack or cast spells.
subject: grapple mechanics clarified

fact: Gyrgum fails a check to break free from the grapple with a roll of 9.
source_quote: Gyrgum tries to break free and fails with a 9.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz fires magic missiles at the Trapper.
source_quote: firing magic missiles into the beast.
subject: Daz

fact: The DM rules that any spell that is not area-of-effect is safe to use on the grappled creature.
source_quote: The DM rules that anything but an area-of-effect spell is safe to use.
subject: AoE rule clarification

fact: Daz attempts to use Silvery Barbs but realizes it requires an attack, check, or save to trigger.
source_quote: Daz first tries Silvery Barbs but realises it needs an attack, check, or save to trigger.
subject: Daz

fact: Daz notes his mistake regarding Silvery Barbs.
source_quote: He notes, "I need to remember that, though."
subject: Daz

fact: The party is confirmed to be at level 4.
source_quote: The party is confirmed to be at level 4.
subject: session date

fact: Zalthir locks the Trapper in a counter-grapple.
source_quote: Zalthir rushes forward, striking the monstrosity with an unarmed blow and locking it in a counter-grapple
subject: Zalthir counter-grapple

fact: Zalthir uses his grappler's advantage to land repeated strikes.
source_quote: using his grappler's advantage to land repeated strikes.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir lands two follow-up attacks with advantage.
source_quote: Two follow-up attacks with advantage both hit.
subject: Zalthir attacks

fact: Zalthir decides not to drag the creature because it would also drag Gyrgum.
source_quote: Dragging the creature would only drag Gyrgum too, so Zalthir stays put.
subject: dragging aborted

fact: Thorin hits the Trapper with his longsword for 12 damage.
source_quote: The longsword hits for 12.
subject: Thorin longsword attack

fact: Thorin uses Hill Strike to add 4 damage and force a DC 14 Strength save against falling prone.
source_quote: His Hill Strike adds 4 damage and a DC 14 Strength save against falling prone
subject: Thorin Hill Strike

fact: The Trapper passes the Strength save against falling prone.
source_quote: which the Trapper passes.
subject: Trapper

fact: Thorin's Sap mastery gives the Trapper disadvantage on its next attack roll.
source_quote: The Sap mastery gives the creature disadvantage on its next attack roll.
subject: Thorin Sap mastery

fact: Thorin uses Sentinel to claim an opportunity attack.
source_quote: Sentinel is mentioned, and Thorin claims an opportunity attack.
subject: Thorin

fact: The Trapper saves against Daz's Toll the Dead.
source_quote: The Trapper saves against Toll the Dead.
subject: Daz Toll the Dead

fact: Daz forces the Trapper to reroll the save with Silvery Barbs, but it succeeds again.
source_quote: Daz forces a reroll with Silvery Barbs, but it succeeds again.
subject: Daz Silvery Barbs

fact: Gyrgum gains advantage on his next roll due to Daz's spell.
source_quote: Gyrgum still gains advantage on his next roll
subject: Gyrgum advantage

fact: Daz promises to use Silvery Barbs to force rerolls every round.
source_quote: and Daz promises to do this every round.
subject: Daz

fact: Zalthir strikes the Trapper until it collapses dead.
source_quote: beat the enormous predator into the ground with a relentless series of strikes until it collapsed, dead.
subject: Trapper killed

fact: The Trapper is dead.
source_quote: it collapsed, dead.
subject: Trapper

fact: The dead Trapper releases Gyrgum onto the cave floor.
source_quote: It released a battered and thoroughly acid-covered Gyrgum onto the cave floor.
subject: Gyrgum released

fact: Gyrgum is covered in acid residue.
source_quote: thoroughly acid-covered Gyrgum
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum scrapes the caustic residue off himself with visible disgust.
source_quote: Gyrgum scraped the caustic residue off himself with visible disgust
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum complains about the 'icky stuff'.
source_quote: Gyrgum scrapes the acid off himself: "I can't abide that sort of icky stuff, you know?"
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The Ember Vanguard presses on into the dark after the fight.
source_quote: and the Ember Vanguard pressed on into the dark.
subject: Ember Vanguard

fact: The DM promises the next session will not involve discussing Ubiquiti networking devices.
source_quote: "next week, we will not spend 40 minutes discussing Ubiquiti networking devices."
subject: next session promise

fact: Daz teases a show-and-tell for the next session.
source_quote: Daz teased a show-and-tell for next time.
subject: show-and-tell teaser
